newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends weaker vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc busy.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends weaker vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc busy.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended weaker against the dollar amid extremely light activity on Monday, dealers said.
"Liquidity was minimal amid a complete lack of interest," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria.
The forint closed at 169.22/27 against the U.S. unit, compared with an opening of 169.05/10, and some 15 pips weaker than the central bank bid.

On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Swiss franc futures accounted for 11,300 contracts out of a total 19,290 contracts, or 3.05 billion forints turnover. The Swiss franc eased in March and December but rose for September.
German mark futures were mainly steady in all months except in March and December, where prices rose. Dollar futures ended higher across all maturities.
Ecu and sterling futures closed mixed, while the Italian lira was unchanged.
